description: This file implements a general-purpose undo manager with undo/redo functionality, including command registration, execution, and state management.

classes.name: UndoManager
classes.description: A class managing undo and redo operations with command history, including methods for performing, registering, undoing, redoing, and clearing commands.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Executes a redo operation, registers the undo command, and returns the result.

methods.name: registerUndo
methods.description: Registers a new undo/redo command with optional description, group ID, and discardable flag.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last command or group of commands.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Redoes the last undone command or group of commands.
